description: How often the clients look at things, and how long they wait. Three clients that behave alike have the same patience: a node list refreshed every minute on one platform and every five on another is two products, not one. The pending window is the one that is not a poll: every pairing answer carries the gateway's own pending_expires_at, a staged pairing is alive exactly until that instant, and a client that cannot read it refuses the pairing rather than inventing a window of its own. Each client asserts its own constants against these, so a cadence changed in one place is changed everywhere or the tests say so.
